report.metric: Distance 0 (identical) to 1, the mean of six parts measured from the notes each tune plays in its first 90 s after GO: tempo, drums (kick and snare step patterns, hat density, break share), bass (rhythm and pitch classes), harmony (chord transitions and how often they change), melody (rhythm, interval shapes, how much of the time it plays, shared three-interval figures) and instruments (the set of sounds that play).
